headline: Krishival Foods Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - Krishival Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, please find enclosed herewith the disclosure received from…
detail: Updates - Krishival Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Pursuant to Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, please find enclosed herewith the disclosure received from the Promoter / Promoter Group, by way of allotment of Shares through right issue.'.
